author: imurs
body: I was just wondering if there was any team I could join. A little about my self: Over the course of avicus, I've destroyed about 600 monuments and killed about 7,000 people. I might not be the fantastic pvper that everyone wants, but at least I can rush. My old IGN was ahmed890, but I had to change it for the racism I was receiving on this server.
